title: Good Roots Network API
description:
REST API for the community food coordination platform. Covers user profiles,
crop libraries, surplus listings, food requests, claims, reminders,
AI-assisted guidance, pro analytics, and billing.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Which slice of the queue to return. Defaults to `pending` — omitting
it does not mean "all". Any other value is a 400.

responses.description: status was not one of pending, approved, denied

operations.description:
Records the approval. No credential is created here — approval only
unlocks the requester's ability to mint one key for themselves.

Repeating the same decision returns 200 without re-emitting the
notification; the opposite decision on an already-decided request
returns 409.

Records the refusal, with an optional note shown to the requester. The
same idempotency rules as approval apply.

operations.description:
Returns the private harvest log for a single crop: the running total
brought in, the number of entries, and every logged harvest newest-first.
This is personal bookkeeping and is separate from surplus listings.

operations.summary: Log a harvest for one crop
operations.description:
Records how much was brought in for this crop and returns the new entry
plus the updated running total. When `unit` is omitted it falls back to
the crop's `default_unit`; when `harvestedOn` is omitted it defaults to
today.
Permanently removes one harvest entry. The running total is recomputed on the next read.

Updates one harvest entry and returns it plus the recomputed running
total. When `harvestedOn` is omitted the existing date is kept; when
`unit` is omitted it falls back to the crop's `default_unit`.

operations.description:
Idempotent: an active link is returned unchanged; a revoked or
missing one gets a freshly minted token so a previously leaked URL
stays dead.

operations.summary: Public read-only view of a shared garden
operations.description:
Unauthenticated. Returns a privacy-trimmed snapshot of the garden:
canvas dimensions, bed and annotation geometry, and the names of
non-private crops. No user identity, free-text notes, or contact
data. Unknown and revoked tokens both return a constant 404.

Builds the private journal for a season from the grower's own records.
Defaults to the current season when `season` is omitted.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Four-digit year. Defaults to the current season.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Required. Retrying with the same key returns the original result
instead of creating a second entry. Omitting it is a 400.

operations.summary: Get an upload URL for a journal photo
operations.description:
Returns a short-lived presigned URL. Upload the photo with the returned
method and headers, then reference the key when creating the note.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Optional. Retrying with the same key returns the original result
rather than creating a duplicate; reusing a key for different
content is the 409 below.

operations.summary: Update user profile and role-specific configuration

operations.description:
Returns this user's access requests, newest first, so the requester can
see whether a decision has been made and whether a key has been claimed
against an approval.

Opens a request for programmatic access. Approval is manual, and a key is
not minted here — once approved, the requester claims the secret
themselves via `POST /me/api-keys` so it never passes through a reviewer.

Only one request may be open at a time; asking again while one is pending
returns 409.

responses.description: A request is already open for this user

operations.summary: List the current user's API keys
operations.description: Returns non-secret metadata for the user's active API keys. Secrets are never returned here.

Creates a new API key for the current user and returns the full secret
exactly once. The key authenticates as the owning user when sent as
`Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

responses.description: Created API key, including the one-time secret
